name: 550W AI Subtitle & Watermark Remover
description: Remove hardcoded video subtitles, watermarks from TikTok and other supported short-video share links, and image watermarks or unwanted text; check tasks and credits. Copy a video share link in the app to use it.
description_zh: 去除视频硬字幕、抖音/快手/Bilibili/微博/小红书等短视频分享链接水印、图片水印或多余文字，并查询任务和积分。在 App 内复制视频分享链接即可使用。
description_en: Remove hardcoded video subtitles, watermarks from TikTok and other supported short-video share links, and image watermarks or unwanted text; check tasks and credits. Copy a video share link in the app to use it.
examples_zh: 去掉这个视频里的字幕
我在抖音 App 内复制了这条视频的分享链接，帮我去水印
去掉这张图片上的文字水印
examples_en: Remove the subtitles from this video
I copied this TikTok video share link in the app. Remove its watermark.
Remove the text watermark from this image
